result.planSummary: Implemented deterministic smooth-turn generation for closed turns with persisted readiness/strategy metadata, a fixed marker-based formatter and tool-output policy, plus a new story-level test suite covering all Story 1 TCs and the decided empty-section case.

changedFiles.reason: Expanded persisted turn smooth metadata to store readiness, strategy, generation timestamp, and source revision alongside text/token count.
Added smooth-state read result types and conversion helpers for persisted turn smooth records.
Added deterministic smooth-text formatting with fixed section markers, whitespace normalization, stable object serialization, and deterministic tool-output truncation/removal rules.
Implemented smooth-state inspection and repair for turns, including stale/invalid detection and persisted regeneration for closed turns.
Added Story 1 coverage for all smooth-turn acceptance criteria plus the empty/noise-only section decided test using real stored thread/message/turn records.

findingsFixed: Persisted full smooth-turn metadata on turn records so missing, stale, invalid, and ready states are distinguishable and repairable.
Moved deterministic formatting into a dedicated helper with fixed actor markers and tool-output policy so later chunking can rely on stable structure.
Added realistic service tests that exercise real message/part/turn records instead of a pre-joined string, including oversized tool output and omitted noise-only sections.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to Story 2, using the persisted smooth readiness/token metadata as the input seam for deterministic chunk lifecycle work.
